items.name: Coconut Date Cloud
items.description: Creamy overnight oats blended with coconut, almond milk, and dates, topped with shredded coconut for a naturally sweet and delicious start to your day.

items.name: Mocha Overnight Oats
items.description: Your morning coffee and breakfast rolled into one. Creamy oats infused with rich espresso and dark cocoa, naturally sweetened and packed with wholesome goodness. Decadent, energising, and 100% plant-based.

items.name: Apple Cinnamon
items.description: Like apple pie in a jar, without the fuss. Creamy rolled oats infused with fragrant cinnamon, vanilla, and sweet spiced apples, topped with a satisfying crunch. Cozy, wholesome, and 100% plant-based.

items.name: Choco-Mond Oatmeal
items.description: Creamy chocolate oats with almond milk, maple syrup, chia seeds, and peanut butter, topped with vanilla granola, fresh strawberries, and banana.

items.name: Super Blue Chia Pudding
items.description: Creamy chia pudding made with almond milk and blue spirulina, naturally smooth, refreshing, and packed with superfood goodness.

items.name: Strawberry Overnight Oats
items.description: A dreamy, cloud-like breakfast treat. Creamy coconut-soaked oats layered with whipped date caramel and fresh, juicy strawberries. Naturally sweet, ultra-creamy, and 100% plant-based.

items.name: Açaí Bowl
items.description: A creamy blend of açaí, strawberry, blueberry, banana, and almond milk, topped with crunchy granola and fresh fruits for a refreshing, naturally sweet, and nourishing bowl

items.name: Pitaya Bowl
items.description: A creamy blend of vibrant pitaya, juicy mango, and almond milk, topped with crunchy granola and fresh fruits for a refreshing, naturally sweet, and wholesome bowl.

items.name: Cosmic Blue Bowl
items.description: A creamy blend of banana, pineapple, mango, blue spirulina, and almond milk, topped with crunchy granola and fresh fruits for a vibrant, tropical, and nourishing superfood bowl.

items.name: PB Cloud
items.description: Creamy banana and peanut butter smoothie, naturally sweet, rich, and satisfying. Perfect for a wholesome breakfast or post-workout boost.

items.name: Creamy Dreamy Avo Toast
items.description: Creamy smashed avocado spread over toasted bread, topped with fresh vegetables and a delicious blend of herbs and seasonings for a simple, wholesome, and satisfying bite.

items.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Toast
items.description: Thick artisan toast layered with rich dark chocolate, creamy peanut butter, warm caramelised bananas, and fresh strawberries.

items.name: Apple Broccoli Toast
items.description: Crisp apple and tender broccoli atop artisanal whole grain toast, layered with creamy vegan spread and finished with a colourful medley of fresh garden vegetables.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Toast
items.description: Thick artisan toast layered with a creamy herb spread and crowned with garlic-sautéed wild mushrooms. Finished with fresh thyme and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a deep, savoury, earthy bite.

items.name: Golden Shroom Strips
items.description: Hand-pulled oyster mushroom strips coated in a seasoned, golden herb crust and fried to absolute perfection. Served with house-made vegan mayo for the ultimate savoury bite.

items.name: Vegan Cheese Balls
items.description: Golden, crispy-coated spheres featuring a warm, decadently melty and savoury plant-based cheese centre. Fried to absolute perfection and served alongside a zesty dipping sauce for the ultimate indulgence.

items.name: Verde Sunset Tacos
items.description: Bite-sized perfection featuring spiced tofu crumbles topped with bright pico de gallo and fresh cilantro, served straight from a modern metal taco holder.

items.name: Smash Pops
items.description: Golden, bite-sized morsels crafted from fluffy smashed potatoes, tender broccoli, and sweet carrots, crisped to absolute perfection on the outside and served with a zesty, house-made dipping sauce.

items.name: Crunchy Saigon
items.description: Experience the ultimate satisfying crunch. These vegan rolls are packed with a flavourful blend of fresh vegetables and seasoned tofu, topped with crispy garlic bits. Dip into our spicy-sweet chilli sauce for a perfect balance of flavours.

items.name: No-Yolker Wrap
items.description: Vegan soy egg bhurji wrapped in a soft tortilla with crisp lettuce and creamy vegan mayo.

items.name: Maple Tofu Quesadilla
items.description: A crispy tortilla filled with grated tofu, fresh vegetables, vegan cheddar, Dijon mustard, and creamy vegan mayo, finished with a touch of maple and served with tomato herb dip.

items.name: Fungi & Fire Wrap
items.description: Authentic Middle Eastern flavours, 100% plant-based. Tender wild oyster mushrooms seasoned in aromatic shawarma spices, roasted to perfection, and rolled with crisp vegetables and creamy garlic tahini.

items.name: All Plant Falafel Roll
items.description: Authentic Mediterranean falafel wrapped in a soft tortilla with fresh vegetables, creamy tahini, and crisp greens.

items.name: Rainbow Rice Wraps
items.description: Delicate rice paper wraps filled with crisp lettuce, fresh garden vegetables, golden fried tofu and fragrant herbs, served with a rich, creamy peanut dipping sauce.

items.name: BBQ Tofu
items.description: Smoky, bold, and endlessly satisfying. Pan-seared tofu smothered in a sweet-and-smoky BBQ glaze, layered with crisp coleslaw and tangy pickles inside a warm, toasted ciabatta. Pure plant-based comfort in every bite.

items.name: Tofu Delight Sandwich
items.description: Fluffy, savoury, and loaded with goodness. Spiced plant-based tofu scramble folded with fresh garden vegetables and creamy avocado spread on toasted artisan bread. The ultimate cruelty-free morning fuel.

items.name: Pesto Tempeh
items.description: Herbaceous, nutty, and bursting with flavour. Golden pan-seared tempeh tossed in vibrant, dairy-free basil pesto, layered with fresh greens and ripe tomatoes inside a warm, crusty ciabatta.

items.name: Forest Gold Burger
items.description: A hearty chickpea and mushroom patty layered with fresh vegetables and house-made sauce, served on a soft, freshly baked vegan bun served with potato wedges on the side.

items.name: No-Bull Burger
items.description: Big flavour, zero compromise. A savoury, umami- packed tempeh mock beef patty char-grilled to perfection, layered with crisp greens, ripe tomato, caramelised onions, and house-made vegan aioli on a toasted bun served with potato wedges on the side.

items.name: The Golden Stack
items.description: Crispy tofu glazed with a rich maple and soy reduction, layered with fresh lettuce, tomato, and house-made vegan mayo on a soft, freshly baked vegan bun served with potato wedges on the side.

items.name: Arrabbiata Classica
items.description: Fettuccine tossed in a bold Arrabbiata sauce made with slow-simmered tomatoes, garlic, chilli, fresh basil, and mushrooms finished with extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Garden Pesto Pasta
items.description: Spiral fusilli tossed in a vibrant, dairy-free pesto of fresh basil, mushrooms, rich soaked cashews, and toasted pumpkin seeds. Finished with a drizzle of cold-pressed olive oil for a naturally creamy, herbaceous, and satisfyingly crunchy bowl.

items.name: Foothill Farfalle Pasta
items.description: Farfalle pasta tossed in a velvety house-made vegan cream sauce with sautéed mushrooms, finished with fragrant herbs and cracked black pepper.

items.name: Mushroom Bolognese
items.description: Rich, comforting, and deeply savoury. Slow- simmered minced mushrooms and aromatic vegetables in a rich tomato herb ragù, tossed with silky fettuccine pasta. A hearty, 100% plant-based Italian favourite.

items.name: Buddha Bowl
items.description: A wholesome bowl of herbed brown rice, caramelised tofu, sautéed mushrooms and broccoli, paired with fresh cucumber, carrot, radish, and creamy avocado slices.

items.name: Earth & Grain Bowl
items.description: A wholesome mix of quinoa, chickpeas, fresh cucumber, carrot, and red cabbage, finished with a creamy tahini dressing for a fresh, colourful, and satisfying vegan meal.

items.name: The Coastal Bowl
items.description: Golden falafel served with creamy hummus, tahini, herbed grains, and a vibrant chickpea salad with onion, sumac, fresh vegetables, and Mediterranean herbs.

items.name: Mexican Midnight Bowl
items.description: A midnight craving reinvented. Earthy black rice topped with smoky, char-grilled Sriracha BBQ oyster mushrooms and sweet sautéed bell peppers, crowned with a bright, zesty Mexican salsa. Bold, smoky, and 100% plant-based.

items.name: Harissa Tofu Bowl
items.description: Hand-crafted vegan tofu meatballs infused with aromatic herbs and spices, then seared and tossed in a bold, smoky North African harissa sauce with a fiery kick.

items.name: Red Rice and Miso Glazed Bowl
items.description: A savoury, umami-packed Japanese-inspired bowl featuring vegetables caramelised in a rich miso glaze, with a perfect balance of sweet, salty, and deep fermented notes.

items.name: Butter Tofu and Coconut Rice Bowl
items.description: Rich, velvety, and deeply comforting. Golden tofu simmered in a spiced, creamy tomato-cashew butter gravy, served alongside fragrant coconut rice. A luxurious plant-based twist on a timeless classic.

items.name: Thai Red Coconut Curry Bowl with Brown Rice
items.description: Aromatic, creamy, and deeply comforting. Golden tofu and tender vegetables simmered in a rich coconut red curry, served over wholesome brown rice. A vibrant bowl bursting with authentic Southeast Asian flavour.

items.name: Golden Tide Roll
items.description: Crisp, golden-crusted tofu paired with creamy avocado and fresh, vibrant garden vegetables wrapped in seasoned white sushi rice. Clean, wholesome, and bursting with flavour in every bite— served with a side of savoury soya dip & wasabi.

items.name: Ocean-Free Horizon
items.description: Delicate, plant-based salmon paired with silky avocado and crisp garden vegetables, wrapped in seasoned sushi rice and nori with wasabi. A tender, melt-in-your-mouth experience with every bite.

items.name: Root and Reef Roll
items.description: Earthy beetroot-infused sushi rice wrapped around savoury, pan-seared tempeh and crisp, garden-fresh vegetables with wasabi. A striking, nutrient-packed fusion of bold colours and wholesome, plant-based flavours.

items.name: Granola Bites
items.description: A wholesome powerhouse of natural energy— expertly rolled from chewy dates, creamy peanut butter, and hearty rolled oats.

items.name: Midnight Brownie
items.description: Rich, fudgy vegan brownie crafted with premium dark cocoa, baked to perfection with a soft, gooey center and an irresistibly decadent finish.

items.name: Caramel Eclipse Cake
items.description: Rich, velvety chocolate sponge coated in a glossy dark chocolate ganache and crowned with whipped vegan caramel. Deeply indulgent, wonderfully moist, and balanced with a subtle hint of buttery sweetness in every bite.

items.name: Chocolate Bliss Cookie
items.description: Soft-baked vegan chocolate cookies loaded with rich dark chocolate chunks, crisp on the edges and irresistibly chewy at the center.

items.name: Fruit Tart
items.description: Delicate, crisp mini vegan pastry shells filled with a silky, velvety vanilla bean custard. Topped with a vibrant medley of fresh, seasonal fruit pieces for a burst of natural sweetness in every bite.

items.name: Walnut Pie
items.description: Flaky artisan shortcrust pastry filled with toasted California walnuts in a rich, amber-sweet maple caramel. Decadently nutty, wonderfully gooey, and baked to a golden-brown perfection for a timeless comfort-food experience.

items.name: Ruby Hibiscus Chill
items.description: A ruby-red cooler of tart hibiscus petals and bright, zesty citrus. Chilled and naturally sweetened.

items.name: Crisp Lemon Chill
items.description: Crisp iced tea with freshly squeezed lemon juice. Ice-cold, revitalising, with a touch of sweetness.

items.name: Peach Nectar Chill
items.description: Sun-ripened peach nectar with crisp iced tea, sipped over ice.

items.name: Mint
items.description: A fresh dash of peppermint with whole leaves to keep you refreshed.

items.name: Rose
items.description: A sweet, comforting blend of whole leaves and fragrant rose petals.

items.name: Jasmine
items.description: Earthy whole leaves with soothing jasmine flowers.

items.name: Ginger & Tulsi
items.description: Turmeric and tulsi with the warm aroma of ginger.

items.name: Hibiscus Ritual
items.description: A warm infusion of hibiscus flowers, naturally tangy and floral.
